intent: Bring brother_printer/consumables.py under the 250-line cap by moving the dropped-page detection into its own module, with no behaviour change.
scope: Non-goal: no assertion changed, no test deleted, skipped or weakened
changes: Moved check_page_delivery and _snapshot_counters verbatim into python_pkg/brother_printer/_page_delivery.py, which imports the three state-file primitives from consumables.

The primitives themselves stay in consumables.py: test_consumables.py patches _load_consumable_state, _save_consumable_state, _get_cups_total_pages, CONSUMABLE_STATE_FILE and CUPS_PAGE_LOG on that module, and moving any of them would have let a test write to the real state file at ~/.config/brother_printer/state.json.
consumables.py dropped the now-unused PAGE_DROP_WARN_THRESHOLD and PageDeliveryCheck imports; 279 -> 217 lines.

test_consumables_part2.py gained a second constant MOD_PD alongside MOD, applied only to TestCheckPageDelivery and TestSnapshotCounters. Its other two classes test functions that did not move and keep MOD. This is the per-name discipline docs/python-split-recipes.md requires, not a blanket swap: the same three primitives are patched from both modules, so which MOD is correct depends on which caller the test exercises.
_page_count.py imports check_page_delivery from _page_delivery now; test_page_count.py patches that name on _page_count, so it needed no edit.

verification.evidence: 402 passed before the split and 402 passed after it - identical pass count, not merely a green run.

verification.command: PYTHONPATH=. python3 -c "from python_pkg.brother_printer import _page_delivery as pd, consumables as c, _page_count as pc; pd._load_consumable_state; pd._save_consumable_state; pd._get_cups_total_pages; c.CONSUMABLE_STATE_FILE; c.CUPS_PAGE_LOG; c._migrate_state_to_printer_scale; pc.check_page_delivery"
verification.evidence: runtime probe OK - both MOD and MOD_PD resolve every name their classes patch.
mtime still Jul 17 14:42 after the full suite run, so no test escaped its mock and wrote to the live consumable state. A green pass count alone would not have caught that.
217 and 76 lines, both under the 250-line cap.
ruff, ruff format, mypy, pylint, bandit and pytest-with-coverage all pass on the touched files.

risks: test_consumables_part2.py now carries two module constants; a future edit that patches a state primitive in the wrong one fails loudly with an AttributeError rather than silently, because each name exists in only one of the two modules under its own MOD.
consumables <- _page_delivery <- _page_count is a three-module chain; consumables must never import from _page_delivery or it becomes a cycle.
rollback: git revert the commit; consumables.py returns to 279 lines and _page_delivery.py disappears.
After rollback, re-run the package suite and confirm it still reports 402 passed.
